headline: Morning Business Report: Oil prices rise after Trump rejects Iran ceasefire proposal
summary: Oil prices moved higher after President Donald Trump rejected Iran's ceasefire proposal. Diamond prices hit a record low in the same report.
why: Crude oil is the world's most traded commodity, and Middle East conflict risk to supply routes often lifts prices. Investors track Iran-related developments closely for energy markets.
why_moved: Oil rose after the US President rejected Iran's ceasefire proposal, which raises the prospect of continued Middle East tension affecting supply.
